rv.q: Luke Sookdeo captures Marc’s callousness and impetuousness and has a great rapport with his co-star, but Emmy Stonelake is the beating heart of the play as Aster. Stonelake plays Aster’s nervous energy and endearingly goofy awkwardness brilliantly, but also successfully portrays her heartbreak and dejection when Marc cruelly lashes out at her.
Despite limiting its force, this compassionate play and production ensure, like Aster, that these people are well served.
